title: Vanilla Flavoured
description: This project is a modpack that expands on Minecraft whilst keeping it somewhat vanilla friendly.
body:
**Vanilla Flavoured** is a Fabric modpack for **Minecraft 1.21.1** designed to expand the game in a **Vanilla+** direction enhancing what Minecraft already does best without losing its original charm.

This modpack focuses heavily on **exploration and immersion**, breathing new life into both familiar and uncharted territory. The **Overworld** is enriched with new structures by **Dungeons and Taverns**, encouraging adventure, discovery, and storytelling as you travel the world. The **Nether** and **End** are reimagined with **Better Nether** and **Better End**, adding stunning biomes, unique resources, and a sense of wonder while staying true to Minecraft’s aesthetic.

Beyond the core dimensions, *Vanilla Flavoured* introduces **two brand-new dimensions** to explore: the legendary **Aether**, floating above the clouds, and an expanded, more mysterious **Deep Dark**, offering dangerous challenges and atmospheric exploration.

The pack is **highly optimized**, ensuring smooth performance on Fabric, while also being **visually pleasing** through subtle enhancements that improve lighting, environments, and overall ambiance—without straying into overly modded territory. Every addition is carefully chosen to feel natural, immersive, and faithful to vanilla gameplay.

If you’re looking for a **polished, exploration-focused modpack** that feels like an evolution of Minecraft rather than a total overhaul, **Vanilla Flavoured** delivers a rich, adventurous experience that stays true to the heart of the game.
